name: Lord Guardian
introduction: The Lord Guardian is a monumental protector of others, who stands with the righteous size of a dragon. They can alter the size of their body, becoming more draconic in the process, and channel great might to aid those under the charge.

items.label: Skills
items.value: Athletics; choose two from Animal Handling, Intimidation, Nature, Perception, and Survival

blocks.text: As a bonus action, you can become one size category larger (all of your equipment increases in size with you), and you remain at that size for 1 minute. While you are this size, you gain the following benefits:

items: Your melee attack reach increases by 5 feet.
When you make a weapon attack, roll a d4 and add it to the attack and damage result.
You can make one melee weapon attack as a bonus action.

blocks.text: You can use this feature a number of times per Rest equal to half your proficiency bonus.

When a creature within your melee weapon reach is targeted by an attack, you can use your reaction to strike the attacking weapon away: make a melee weapon attack, and until the end of this turn, the target may treat your attack roll result as their new armor class (unless it was already higher).
Your hide is strong and resistant to attacks. You have a Damage Threshold equal to your dragoneer level.
When you take the Attack action, you can make three attacks, instead of one.
When you use Lord’s Stature, you can choose to increase by two size categories instead of one, and gain the following additional benefits:

items: Your melee attack reach increases by an additional 5 feet.
Your bonus to attack and damage rolls becomes a d6 instead of a d4.
Your Embodied Strike deals an additional die of damage.
